licences.tatoeba: CC-BY 2.0 FR, https://tatoeba.org; source id per sentence
licences.generated: Written for this dataset (model in `source`), reviewed by a second model; CC-BY-4.0 with the dataset
licences.mined: Mined from public HF text datasets (scripts/mine_tech_sentences.py; dataset id in `source`): hysts-bot-data/daily-papers CC0 compilation of arXiv abstracts, pszemraj/LocalLLaMA-posts ODC-BY, e1879/threads-english-tech-news-sft CC-BY-4.0; lightly edited for casing and digits
licences.manual: Written by hand for this dataset (data/manual/); CC-BY-4.0 with the dataset
licences.enron: Enron email corpus, FERC public release via CMU / corbt/enron-emails; licence status inferred (public record), never formally granted
